scope: All seven NEW actual standing images inspected after city visibility/native changes. Scope is fit and correspondence only; no full-V2 or human appearance acceptance. Carried-light hotspots remain open.

F01_SERVICE_CORE_DOOR_open.png.observation: The native two-panel leaf is visibly open beside the retained stair and handrail. Hardware and stile edges remain fitted; carried-light glare still flattens paint detail.

F01_SERVICE_CORE_DOOR_closed.png.observation: The oblique closed-leaf view retains its casing, hinges and knob plates. The narrow return and doorway remain intact; this image alone does not prove traversal.

F03_SERVICE_CORE_DOOR_open.png.observation: The open leaf and its native hinges remain beside the stair rail without a new missing panel or casing. Bright carried illumination remains open polish.

F03_SERVICE_CORE_DOOR_closed.png.observation: The return view retains the leaf, knob and casing beside the descending stair. The source-written physical input/route contract provides the separate operation and access proof.

F01_riser_bypass.png.observation: The bypass keeps its jamb and riser in place with skirting along the wall. The service fitting remains present; high exposure hides some surface detail.

F02_riser_bypass.png.observation: The retained riser, brackets, wall return and skirting remain in the bypass. No newly missing stock is visible in this scoped comparison.

F02_retained_pipe_port.png.observation: The pitched pipe crosses its fitted upper wall opening and retains the visible supports. The bright image is a fit comparison, not a fabrication or photoreal acceptance grant.
